aboutDescription: A local-first desktop app for learning, with a personal knowledge graph that grows with you.
introConceptDescription: A familiar concept is enough, like **coffee**. On its own it says little: meaning comes from its **relations** to other concepts.
introConnectionsDescription: Coffee has something to do with sleep, but how? Connect **Coffee** to **Sleep** from the circle at the top right, then name the **relation** in the Inspector. There is no right answer: deciding is already understanding.
introViewsDescription: **Views** show different parts of the same graph. Switch between **Energy** and **Rest**: coffee stays the same concept, arranged for each view.
introReviewDescription: Every view has its own **Review**, and the number shows the concepts due. When you open it, you explain each concept in your own words, then see it again with the relations you chose:
introChatNote: In the desktop app, AI chat is in the Inspector, next to Details.
introCompactTitle: Ideas mean more when they connect
introCompactDescription: Nesso is a knowledge graph for learning. Start with familiar **concepts**, then give meaning to the **relations** between them.
introCompactExplore: Tap a concept to explore its notes and connections. Switch views for another perspective, then test yourself with Review.
introCompactDesktopNote: This demo runs in your browser. Edit your graph in Nesso for macOS, Windows and Linux.
notesLinkOpenFailed: Could not open the link. Only HTTPS addresses without embedded credentials are allowed.
storageDescription: Nesso’s graph, views, preferences, chat and plugin data. Credentials stay on this device in the default folder.
storageRestoreConfirm: The new folder will be {{path}} again.
storageCloud: With a cloud-synced folder, keep files available offline and do not edit from multiple devices.
storageMovingDescription: Do not close Nesso or disconnect a drive. Editing is paused until the transfer is complete.
storageVerifying: Saving, transferring and verifying your files.
storageMoved: Data moved. Nesso is now saving only in the new folder.
storageSame: This folder is already active. No change is needed.
storageConfig: The data folder configuration could not be read. No existing data was replaced.
storageUnavailable: The folder is unavailable. Check that it exists and any external drive is connected.
storageDestination: Choose a destination using the folder picker.
storageNested: Choose a folder that is not inside the current data folder or one of its parents.
storageOccupied: The folder already contains files. Choose an empty folder. Existing data will not be merged or overwritten.
storageReadonly: Nesso cannot write to this folder. Check its permissions or choose another folder.
storageSource: The current folder contains an unsupported data file. The transfer was not completed.
storageSpace: There is not enough free space in the destination. Free up space or choose another folder.
storageVerification: File verification failed. The original folder remains active.
storageMoveFailure: The move could not be completed. Check space, permissions and drives. The original folder remains active; partial files may remain in the destination.
storageCleanup: Some transfer files could not be safely removed. The displayed folder is active. Check drives and permissions, resolve any partial or externally changed files, then retry cleanup.
storageBusy: Finish or stop active AI chats or MCP requests, then retry. Another transfer or update installation may also be in progress.
storageSaveFailure: Changes could not be saved in every window. The operation was not performed. Resolve storage errors and retry.
storageOpenFailure: Could not open the data folder. Check that it is still accessible.
backupDescription: Nesso automatically backs up your data every 15 minutes if there are changes, and before a reset or restore. It keeps the latest 10 copies.
backupRestoreConfirm: Replaces your current data and reloads Nesso. This cannot be undone. Nesso backs up the current data first, if readable.
automaticBackupFailed: Backup failed. Check the folder, free space and permissions.
automaticBackupConfig: Backup settings could not be read. Using the default folder.
backupWorkingDescription: Do not close Nesso or disconnect a drive. Editing is paused until the operation is complete.
backupInvalid: The file is not a valid, complete Nesso backup. Current data has not been changed.
backupUnsupported: This backup requires a newer version of Nesso. Current data has not been changed.
backupFailed: Could not complete the backup operation. Check the file, free space and permissions, then retry.
backupRestoreFailed: Restore failed. Previous data is unchanged. Check free space and permissions, then retry.
backupRecoveryRequired: Restore was interrupted and recovery could not be completed. Close and reopen Nesso to recover a consistent state. Do not move or edit the data files.
backupDestination: Save the backup outside Nesso’s data and configuration folders.
backupTooLarge: The backup exceeds the current 16 MiB file limit. No backup was saved.
mcpDescription: Connect external assistants to your graph. Every change needs your approval and can be undone.
mcpAutoStartHint: Once started, the server starts automatically when you open Nesso until you stop it.
mcpClientHint: The token stays valid until you regenerate it.
mcpRegenerateDescription: The current token stops working and the server restarts with a new token. Update your external assistants with the new configuration. Your graph stays unchanged.
mcpUndoApproval: An external MCP client requests Undo on the shared document history.
mcpRedoApproval: An external MCP client requests Redo on the shared document history.
aiStarterHelpPrompt: Give me an overview of Nesso and its basics: concepts, relations, views and vocabularies. Also explain what plugins are for and how AI can help me. Use simple language.
aiStarterAnalysisPrompt: Analyze the entire graph, not just the active view. Summarize the main themes, assess how concepts and relations are organized, and identify possible gaps or useful connections.
aiStarterAddPrompt: Add two concepts relevant to the content of this graph and connect them to existing concepts using the available relation types.
aiStarterViewPrompt: Create a view about a common topic using concepts already in the graph, without duplicating them.
